components.name: Text field
components.description: A persistent label and readable editable value.

components.name: Chapter navigation
components.description: Direct access with an explicit current chapter.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dedecf);border-radius:13px;background:#f0f0e6;gap:3px}.ds-nav button{font:600 15px/1.25 'Trebuchet MS','Segoe UI',sans-serif;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;min-height:43px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:400;padding:15px 17px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#202d23)}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#e8ecdf}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{background:var(--forest,#294a38);color:#fffdf4}.ds-nav button[aria-current]:hover{background:#365c45}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #946223;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Selected coat swatch
components.description: A color choice with a visible selected checkmark.
components.css: .ds-swatch{font:600 15px/1.25 'Trebuchet MS','Segoe UI',sans-serif;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;min-height:43px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:5px 12px;background:var(--forest-light,#e8eedf);outline:1px solid var(--forest,#294a38);color:var(--forest,#294a38)}.ds-swatch span{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#a4ba99;border:1px solid #0002;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 1px #000}.ds-swatch small{font-size:11px}.ds-swatch:hover{background:#dce4d1}.ds-swatch:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #946223;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Companion collection entry
components.description: A named, reopenable companion with a compact summary.
components.css: .ds-companion{font:600 15px/1.25 'Trebuchet MS','Segoe UI',sans-serif;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;min-height:43px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;text-align:left;padding:14px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dedecf);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel,#fffdf7);color:var(--ink,#202d23)}.ds-companion strong{display:block;font:600 18px Georgia,serif}.ds-companion small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font:12px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#626955)}.ds-symbol{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:43px;background:var(--forest-light,#e8eedf);border-radius:8px}.ds-companion:hover{background:#e8ecdf}.ds-companion:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #946223;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The supplied Littlewild Character Studio mockups and walkthrough establish the
visual direction: cream paper, forest controls, restrained gold actions and serif
headings. The interface places readable controls beside the real authored model.
The rendered companion supplies the expressive detail; chrome stays quiet and
legible through repeated editing.

This is an operational editor. Selected states, field labels, persistence feedback
and keyboard focus remain visible. A portrait or world backdrop is another view
of the compiled model, not a replacement illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with dark forest selections.
Serif headings paired with familiar system controls.
A large live model beside a compact chapter panel.
Explicit save feedback, full labels and visible focus.

rules.name: The Selection Rule
rules.body: Forest fill indicates the active choice; gold identifies the main review or commit action.

dos: Do use gold for the review or commit action and forest for selected controls.
Do keep editable numeric values beside appearance sliders.
Do reserve room around the model for camera, lighting and pose controls.
Do preserve visible focus and respect reduced motion and larger text.
donts: Don't use mockup artwork in place of the live authored companion model.
Don't rely on color alone for a selected swatch or a field error.
Don't hide save failures or imply that a browser save reached project disk.
